Recent issue reports mention similar encoding or escaping problems in related UI components, reinforcing the suspicion that this method lacks proper handling. The behavior observed in the code matches the issue report's symptoms, indicating that missing escaping in this method is the likely root cause.

After providing this diagnosis, you will be prompted to suggest which methods would be the best locations to be fixed. messages.content:
The issue here seems to be related to the change in the format of the message returned by `MissingOptionException.getMessage()` from CLI version 1.0 to version 1.1. In CLI version 1.0, the message was poorly formatted but readable, whereas in CLI version 1.1, it became almost unreadable due to changes in how option keys are formatted.

Looking at the provided test case `testMissingRequiredOptions`, it is adding an option with a long option "cfile" which is marked as required. When parsing the arguments, an exception of type `MissingOptionException` is expected to be thrown due to the missing required option. The test then checks if the exception message matches the expected value.

The changes in the formatting of the exception message are likely a result of how options are stored and retrieved in the `Options` class, specifically in the `addOption(Option opt)` method. In CLI 1.0, the stored options were prefixed with a "-", while in CLI 1.1, they are not.

To address this issue, it is suggested to update the `addOption(Option opt)` method in the `org.apache.commons.cli.Options` class to ensure that the option keys are formatted consistently to maintain the readability of the exception messages.

Next, I will provide the best locations to fix this issue.
org.apache.commons.cli.Options.addOption(org.apache.commons.cli.Option)

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
